query: If firm participation or data quality fall short, which fallback analytic designs (synthetic control, single-firm longitudinal case study) will be pre-specified and what inferential limits will we report?

response.query: If firm participation or data quality fall short, which fallback analytic designs (synthetic control, single-firm longitudinal case study) will be pre-specified and what inferential limits will we report?
response.answer: If firm participation or data quality fall short, we will use synthetic control and single-firm longitudinal case study designs. We will report inferential limits due to reduced data reliability.
